The '''Territorial Enforcers''' were a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group in the employ of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], some of whose members were recruited by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[K'krohl]].
